a: Sync (HTTP/gRPC) is simple; async (queues/events) decouples and buffers.
Clients find instances via DNS, registries, or mesh control planes.
Gateway handles external auth, routing, and aggregation.
Separate BFFs tailor payloads for mobile vs web clients.
Prefer sagas and eventual consistency over 2PC across services.
Always set deadlines; cascading retries without budgets cause outages.
Consumer-driven contracts catch breaking API changes early.
Sharing DBs couples services; prefer APIs and events.
Meshes can encrypt and authenticate service-to-service traffic.
